issues.title: Closed, solid mesh
issues.message: The model has 0 open edges and 2 non-manifold edges, so it is not a sealed solid. The slicer may fill it wrongly or skip parts of it.
issues.suggestion: Close the holes in your CAD tool or run a repair (e.g. Windows 3D Builder, PrusaSlicer 'Repair', or Meshmixer 'Make Solid') and re-export.

issues.title: 1 mm bottom chamfer
issues.message: Recommend adding 1mm chamfer to the base of all parts for maximum reliability and highest tolerance.

issues.title: Requires Support
issues.message: About 87 mm² of overhangs (35° or less from horizontal) will need support. Highlighted areas show where.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.
